# LogistiCore Technologies

> IT support, logistics SaaS, and web design for UK businesses. LogistiCore SaaS is a freight forwarding platform with air, sea, road, courier, warehouse, and HMRC CDS customs.

- Site: https://logisticoreapp.com
- App login: https://app.logisticoreapp.com/app/login
- Sales: sales@logisticoreapp.com
- Support: support@logisticoreapp.com
- Phone: +44 (0) 20 4511 4156

## Products & services

- [LogistiCore SaaS](https://logisticoreapp.com/logisticore-saas.html): Freight forwarding software for UK forwarders, brokers, and 3PLs
- [Partner programme](https://logisticoreapp.com/partners.html): Reseller, referral, implementation, and technology partnerships
- [IT Support](https://logisticoreapp.com/it-support.html): Managed IT services for logistics SMEs
- [Website creation](https://logisticoreapp.com/website-creation.html): Logistics-focused web design
- [UK Air Rates](https://logisticoreapp.com/uk-air-rates.html): Free UK air rate search tool
- [Invoice tool](https://logisticoreapp.com/invoice-tool.html): PDF invoice extraction for customs
- [Pricing](https://logisticoreapp.com/pricing.html)
- [Contact](https://logisticoreapp.com/contact.html)
